Because docker_image is absent, Harbor builds this Dockerfile, so these steps are live, not dead code. Counterexample probe: if a prebuilt docker_image = "node:22-bookworm-slim" were added, /instructions and /assets would be missing and express/better-sqlite3 not preinstalled, breaking the brief's paths for any submission - this task does not do that. A conforming alternative (prebuilt image equal to the Dockerfile build) is not in use either, so no shadowing ambiguity exists.
